question: Who are the closest alternatives to Acme Analytics and how do they differ?

in_scope: direct competitors offering analytics dashboards to mid-market SaaS teams
public pricing pages and official product documentation
out_of_scope: enterprise BI platforms with self-hosted data warehouses

findings.claim: Competitor A prices its entry tier at $49/mo per workspace
Competitor B is converging on per-workspace pricing, suggesting competitive pressure from Competitor A
findings.limitations: Changelog does not state motivation for the pricing change

conflicts.resolution_note: Changelog shows a migration notice only; final pricing page not yet published

implications: Per-workspace pricing appears to be the emerging mid-market norm and should anchor the overall comparison
